devicesHelp: Click „+“ for each device, enter a name and the IP address and choose the device type. Save, then follow the steps shown in the entry. Tip: give the device a fixed IP address in your router.
Name: Name
ipHelp: Shown in the device's network settings
connRemote: Android TV / Google TV (e.g. NVIDIA SHIELD)
connRemoteAdb: Android TV / Google TV + playback info (title, play/pause)
connAdb: Amazon Fire TV (or other device without pairing)
enableImeTooltip: Switch off only if the TV keeps showing 'Use keyboard on mobile device'.
stepPair: Step 1 – Pair (only needed once): switch the device on and click „Start pairing“. A 6-character code appears on the TV. Enter it here and click „Confirm code“ within about a minute.
stepAdbRemote: Step 2 – Allow playback info: on the SHIELD open Settings › Device Preferences › Developer options and switch on „Network debugging“. If the developer options are missing: Settings › Device Preferences › About, click „Build“ 7 times. Then save here. The TV asks „Allow debugging?“ – tick „Always allow“ and confirm.
stepAdbFire: Step 1 – Allow access: on the Fire TV open Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options and switch on „ADB debugging“. If the developer options are missing: Settings › My Fire TV › About, click the device name 7 times. Then save here. The TV asks „Allow USB debugging?“ – tick „Always allow from this computer“ and confirm.
adbSecurity: Note: with debugging switched on, other devices in your home network can access the TV as well. Only use it in your own, trusted network.
appsHelp: Apps you want to start with one click. Each entry becomes a button for every device. Enter the app's web link (e.g. https://www.netflix.com/title). Apps without a link can be entered with their app ID (e.g. Emby: com.mb.android) – this works on Fire TV and with „+ playback info“.
adbPollHelp: Only while the device is switched on.
clientNameHelp: Shown on the TV during pairing
reconnectMaxHelp: If a device is unreachable, the time between attempts grows from 2 s up to this value.
support_text: The adapter is free. If it is useful to you, you can support its development voluntarily.
wolBroadcastHelp: Only needed if the device is in another network (e.g. 192.168.20.255)
